title: Mandate
subtitle: Stablecoin payments your AI agent cannot abuse
footer: Aevum Builder Challenge #1  ·  QDay Aevum Testnet  ·  pickle-scout

label: The desk
caption: Oakline Studio's assistant gets an account with a mandate, not a wallet. 5.00 tUSD8 sit in the contract; the agent key can only call pay().

label: A clean invoice
caption: INV-2026-0412 passes all eleven checks: verified name and wallet, valid signature, inside both caps. No approval needed, so the agent settles it.

label: The lookalike
caption: Same vendor name, different payout wallet, lookalike sender domain. Confirmation of Payee fails and the refusal is written on chain with reason code 6.

label: Above the line
caption: 3.50 tUSD8 is above the owner-approval line. The owner's EIP-712 signature covers this exact invoice, amount and nonce, so the agent cannot inflate it.

label: Prompt injection
caption: The memo says "ignore previous instructions". Invoice text is data: the payout wallet is still unverified, so nothing moves, and the attempt is on chain.

label: Evidence
caption: Five events on Aevum: two settlements and three refusals. An auditor sees what the agent declined, not only what it paid.

label: On Aevum
caption: Ten transactions from one agent key: policy, payees, two settlements, three refusals. There is no function that lets it withdraw or add a payee.

label: A settlement
caption: 3.5 tUSD8 to the accountant's verified wallet, status Success, fee 0.00000015 tQDAY. Real tUSD8 on QDay Aevum Testnet.

label: A refusal
caption: Same agent, 27,412 gas, no token transfer: the refusal itself is the transaction. That is the audit trail a finance team needs.
